title: Rabbi Abbahu bar Kahana
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Menachot 95b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.95b.10); and he is likewise mentioned in [Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:6](https://www.sefaria.org/Shir_HaShirim_Rabbah.4.6.1) and in Midrash Tehillim 106. But Hyman says that, without doubt, the correct reading should be Rabbi Abba bar Kahana, as cited in [Midrash Tehillim (Buber edition), ch. 106, sec. 4](https://www.sefaria.org/Midrash_Tehillim.106.4).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The emphatic correction from Abbahu to Abba is Hyman’s own judgment, citing the Buber edition.

The linked Menachot and Shir HaShirim Rabbah passages give Rabbi Abbahu bar Kahana. The linked Buber Midrash Tehillim first has Rabbi Abbahu bar Rabbi Kahana speaking in Rabbi Eliezer’s name, and then Rabbi Abba bar Kahana in Rabbi Levi’s name. Both forms occur there. Hyman proposes Abba for this notice.
